scope: Shared pure builder, semantic staged framing resolution, qualified source/generated metadata, native capture and delayed cancellation, pending recording gate, integration and replay oracles
supported_finding: A whole-beat Zoom waiting for its exact picture with no Visual selection could survive Escape and submit afterward.
resolution: Idle Escape explicitly cancels camera_pending before delayed picture admission. Recording cannot save while it waits, and recording cancellation revokes that pending entry.
regression: Production replay holds the real stopped-picture reply and tests ordinary, recording and ranged-recording cases, q save refusal, exact bank/body invariants, Escape cancellation, delayed release and absence of stale error.
refuted: The original current.duration() call already resolves exact integral root duration with fractional inner retained clocks. No query change was needed; a real pause-produced derived-clock regression proves root163 and fractional inner refusal.
final_followup: No supported findings after targeted fix review. Reviewer ran no Cargo and made no edits. Runtime qualification reported separately.
followup_findings: Pending ranged framing with a Visual selection cleared it and kept recording on Escape; q-blocked wait error survived cancellation.
followup_resolution: Cancel recording while camera_pending still exists, before generic Escape selection handling. Clear only exact owned PENDING_FRAMING error during cancellation; preserve unrelated errors.
visual_finding: Minimum-size ordinary cancellation capture still displayed Preparing the stopped picture for framing after camera_pending was cleared.
visual_resolution: take_camera_pending clears only its owned PREPARING_PICTURE message when a pending request actually ends, preserving unrelated feedback. Replay asserts no stale preparation status after delayed delivery.
